Hi Grace,

Quick update from our side — procurement and our security/compliance team need to attend the demo next week. Procurement (procure@atlashealth.com) also wants to run through standard terms, and our security team (Ivy Security) will want to walk the data flow and retention story.

Two constraints: I (Mark) will be traveling Nov 25–26 (west coast), and our CISO will only be available in the afternoons PT. Given that, can we either:
- push the demo by one week, or
- split into a 45-minute product overview + 60-minute technical/security session on another day?

We attached our internal procurement checklist for reference (we'll share PO/terms after the call). Can you advise availability and preferred format?

Thanks,
Mark Reynolds
Director, Partnerships — AtlasHealth

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — additional reviewers joining

Hi Mark — thanks for the heads up and the checklist. Totally understand adding procurement & security. We're happy to accommodate either approach, but given the mixed audience it's often smoother to split: an executive/product overview (30–45m) + a technical deep-dive (60–75m) with platform and security present. That gives procurement just the right context and keeps the detailed controls discussion with the engineering team.

Proposed schedule options (all PT):
1) Mon Dec 1 — 11:00–11:45 (overview) + Tue Dec 2 — 10:00–11:15 (tech + security)
2) Tue Dec 2 — 13:00–13:45 (overview) + Wed Dec 3 — 14:00–15:15 (tech + security)
3) Thu Dec 4 — single 90-min session 10:00–11:30 (we can segment agenda)

If any of the above work, we can send separate calendar invites and an updated mutual action plan (attached). If Mark is traveling Nov 25–26, the earliest safe bet is the week of Dec 1. Please let us know availability for the stakeholders and whether procurement wants a short pre-call to confirm contract points.

Attaching: redwood_demo_MAP_v2.pdf (outline + owners)

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0243

- We need a completed security questionnaire at least 48 hours before the technical deep-dive (I can share our standard template).
- Platform and infra should be on the tech session — please loop Jonas Weber (platform) and the infra lead if possible.
- If Atlas wants to discuss retention keys/KMS, have their compliance contacts prepared.

I'll attach our questionnaire and mark the items we must cover live. If we're splitting sessions, please ensure the tech invite includes an agenda line for "data flow, keys, and audit logs".

Soojin

Agree with splitting. From a platform/infra perspective we should run a separate 60–75 min session that includes:
- Architecture walkthrough (KV cache, routing, quantization profiles) — 20m
- Network/topology & VPC/on-prem options — 15m
- Security controls: KMS/HSM, audit logs, data residency — 20m
- Q&A and action items — 15m

My team's availability (PT): Mon Dec 1 after 2pm; Tue Dec 2 all morning until 12:30; Wed Dec 3 after 1pm. If Atlas can do Tue Dec 2 10:00–11:15 that fits both platform+security and gives procurement time on the overview.

I'll prep a brief pre-read covering deployment modes and SLA options — please attach to invites. Also, Soojin: noted on the questionnaire; I'll run the infra answers and return a filled draft within 24 hours.

Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Engineering — Redwood Inference
